purpose: The small, transparent, preregistered set of hindsight oracle exit rules FT2-05 will REPLAY to compute label-side opportunity ceilings. These are ceiling references, never learned policies and never entry targets.

serial_semantics.entry_commit_and_fill: BUY committed at completed t reserves the one position slot; cash/premium uses executable ask at e=t+1
serial_semantics.exit_decision_and_fill: EXIT decided at completed v fills at x=v+1 executable bid; occupancy releases at x
serial_semantics.occupancy_release: at the separately persisted realized t+1 exit-fill minute
serial_semantics.no_bid_forced_flat: actual 15:55 boundary state only; no earlier-bid substitution; no executable bid means $0 option value
serial_semantics.boundary_nonduplication: a committed 15:54 EXIT fills once at 15:55 and suppresses a second forced-flat valuation

census_layer_constraints.session_start_equity_E: account equity carried into the session under v5 within-split compounding; the 5% cap and 5% budget both scale off E

D48_per_trade_premium_cap.rule: a BUY decision at t is eligible only if actual t+1 fill premium plus fee satisfies A_(t+1)*M+3 <= 0.05*E
D48_per_trade_premium_cap.effect: contracts failing the cap are MASKED out of the oracle's choice set exactly like unaffordable/ineligible contracts; the oracle may not select a masked contract
D48_per_trade_premium_cap.same_game: identical mask must hold offline (census + simulator) and in every live/shadow guard

D49_budget_aware_entry.rule: a new oracle BUY committed at t is legal only if realized_session_loss + (A_(t+1)*M+F) <= 0.05*E
D49_budget_aware_entry.realized_session_loss: L = max(0, -(realized net PnL so far this session)); grows only as realized losing exits accumulate
D49_budget_aware_entry.effect: as L grows the eligible ladder narrows; if no otherwise eligible contract with A_(t+1)>=1.00 fits the remaining budget, the session soft-closes to WAIT for new entries

census_layer_constraints.daily_breaker: once L >= 0.05 * E the session takes no further entries (breaker keeps its signed realized-only basis; unchanged by these rules)

oracle_sequencing.principle: an oracle may NEVER take a trade the rules would mask. Entry-fill availability, D48, D49 including the $1 soft-close floor, one-position occupancy, t<15:30 entry decisions, the 15:55 forced-flat boundary, and the 5% daily breaker gate every oracle entry exactly as they gate the model.
oracle_sequencing.serial_ceiling_replay: iterate sessions in split order and completed decision minutes t ascending; maintain equity E, realized session loss L, soft-close state, and occupancy. While flat at t<15:30 and not halted, the oracle may commit one contract only if its executable t+1 ask exists and passes D48/D49. It realizes at the exit rule's t+1 bid fill, updates E and L, and releases occupancy at that fill minute.
oracle_sequencing.threshold_independent_distributions: for the per-contract-minute distribution view (no serial account), each eligible contract-minute path is scored independently under the family formulas; D48 eligibility still gates which contract-minutes exist; D49 (a sequencing constraint) applies only to the serial ceiling replay, not to the independent per-minute distribution. FT2-05 reports both views.

frozen_exit_rules.definition: for each horizon, choose exit-fill minute u* in W(t,h) with maximum executable bid B_(u*); the implied EXIT decision is v=u*-1 and realized fee-adjusted PnL uses B_(u*) against A_(t+1)
frozen_exit_rules.role: per-horizon opportunity ceiling; upper bound on what a perfect within-horizon exit could realize
frozen_exit_rules.censoring: if the horizon is censored near close, the max is taken over available minutes only

frozen_exit_rules.definition: value the still-open position once at the 15:55 forced-flat boundary bid; never substitute an earlier bid; if no executable boundary bid exists, option value is $0
frozen_exit_rules.role: the no-management baseline; what buying and letting it run to the close realizes

frozen_exit_rules.definition: choose the first exit-fill minute u* in W(t,remaining_session) with PnL$(u*)>0; implied EXIT decision is u*-1; if none, use the forced-flat boundary law
frozen_exit_rules.role: the take-the-first-green ceiling; ties directly to family (b) time-to-first-profit and bounds a maximally impatient exit
frozen_exit_rules.justification: authority family (b) defines time-to-first-real-profit; this oracle makes its realized-PnL ceiling explicit for the census

explicitly_not_included: any fixed stop / fixed target / fixed holding-time exit (the authority forbids fixed exits as truth; oracle rules are hindsight-transparent, not learned)
any exit that peeks at the eventual lifecycle model's selected exit
